title: Through the kiln
description: A twisting, fluted cobalt ceramic column opens along a light-blue cut face, revealing seven continuous internal channels.
useCase: Explain the wall and cavity construction of an object without separating it into exploded parts.
interaction: Drag vertically or move the Section slider to inspect a different cut depth.
reducedMotion: The object remains stationary; direct pointer, touch and keyboard input updates the cut immediately.
limitations: A bounded analytic ceramic solid with seven authored channels, not an arbitrary mesh sectioning tool. Requires WebGL 1; a status message appears if unavailable or lost, and the renderer rebuilds on restoration.
look: A sculptural cobalt-blue extrusion with twisting flutes, an angled light-blue cut face, seven internal passages and a thin section control on warm stone white.
motion: Direct section input moves the clipping plane through the solid; the analytic intersection exposes a separately shaded closed cap and continuous cavities.
adapt: Edit `DEFAULT_CONFIG` or pass `config` for wall thickness, cut angle and cap roughness. `ceramic` defines the bounded solid, `scene` intersects it with `planeNormal`, and `u_depth` is onstage section state.
